What good looks like: Work in your industry or a comparable funnel
Question to ask: Which similar businesses have you worked with?
Can you walk me through one end to end?
Can we see anonymised platform or CRM evidence?
Who will work on our account day to day?
How would you set our CPL / CAC targets?
Can we see a sample report?
How will you verify conversion tracking?

What good looks like: Client owns ad accounts and data
Question to ask: Whose name are the ad accounts in?

What good looks like: Fee separated from media and production
Question to ask: What exactly is included and excluded?

What good looks like: Fair notice period and exit terms
Question to ask: What happens if we part ways?
How often will we meet and who attends?

What good looks like: Understands your sales cycle and regulation

Question to ask: Can we speak to two current clients?

What good looks like: Access controls and data handling policy
Question to ask: How do you store and protect our data?
